policy.every_run: Every source in the expressly selected market segments must get a recorded attempt; no silent shortlist.
policy.international: Separate opt-in segment. An explicitly worldwide run includes every segment.
policy.failure: Use host browser or public employer source; unresolved access never equals zero jobs.
policy.scope: Research catalog only. Adding a row does not implement a scraper or execute a browser check.
policy.profession: No hardcoded occupation, CV, salary or language filter.
policy.completion: A run cannot claim coverage while unattempted sources remain.
